_note: 2_04 'Race the Vale' — Petey talks Jimmy into the preps' beach race: ride to the beach together, then one lap of the Vale course against three prep racers for a podium (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_04-race-the-vale.md). FIRST RACE — introduces the framework's minimal data-driven race primitive (race_start; see MissionSubsystem.h): the course is any trigger-file path (here the real 72-waypoint _2_04_RACE loop), the player passes its waypoints in order (checkpoint radius 900), laps x N, fires race:<id>_win. Rival riders are plain data (spawn_npc + npc_move_to on the same course at sprint); the first rival home fires npc_arrived:<id> -> the stage's fail ('you lost'). Built so 3_R08's 14-race series can reuse it (its courses are trigger paths too). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-04 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the bikes are not spawned and the get-on-the-bike gate is skipped (no vehicle bundle / player_mounted condition — the race runs mounted or on foot); Petey's ride-along is a real npc_move_to along _2_04_PetePath (he's not on a bike); the race-intro camera flyover and the owner's countdown node are a letterbox speech beat + the race itself; the RL_rich1 barrier dressing swap, the crowd cheerers/re-seat and the shortcut sub-paths are skipped (world_state_swap/crowd_ring pending; the shortcuts are just the main course for us); rubber-band AI is skipped (rivals run a flat sprint — the smoke driver always beats them; a human on foot will not, bikes help); race position HUD is skipped. Retry: our retry:"stage" restarts at the race — the original's saved-data checkpoint (flag 23) does exactly that too, so this one compression lands free. No SMissPass branch (VERIFIED absence); the campaign on_pass pays $15 (banner value 1500); preppies -10 respect is relative and omitted (set-only table). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Race the Vale

stages.objective: Petey has a race for you.

on_start.sub: The preps think they own the beach roads.

lines.speaker: PETEY
lines.text: Jimmy! The preps are running a bike race down at the beach. You have to show them up — for all of us!

stages.objective: Ride with Petey to the beach.

lines.speaker: RACE OWNER
lines.text: One lap of the Vale. First across the line takes the purse.

lines.speaker: GORD
lines.text: Hope you brought a real bike, pauper.

stages.objective: One lap of the Vale. Win it.

on_start.text: Follow the course — first one back to the line wins.

lines.speaker: RACE OWNER
lines.text: The Bullworth kid takes it! Here's your purse, son.

lines.speaker: JIMMY
lines.text: Tell the Aquaberry boys to practice.

on_complete.text: campaign on_pass for 2_04 pays $15 (banner value 1500); no SMissPass branch (VERIFIED absence); preppies -10 omitted (relative)
